name: Govee Light Installation
metaTitle: Govee Permanent Light Installer | Ontario & GTA Homes
metaDescription: Professional Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights installation for London Ontario and GTA homes. Clean concealed mounting, safe wiring, app setup. Free quote.
heroIntro: Professional mounting, wiring and app configuration for Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights, so the system works right from day one.
intro: Govee's permanent outdoor lighting system is designed to be installed once and used year round, for holidays, everyday accent lighting, or anything in between, but getting the track concealed cleanly and the power wired properly is a different job than hanging seasonal string lights. Our crew installs Govee permanent systems on rooflines and trim, running the track so it disappears against your fascia rather than sitting on top of it.

Beyond mounting, we handle the electrical side, planning where power draws from and making sure wiring is routed safely, then pair the system to your app and set up your first scenes so it works when we leave. Permanent LED installs like this typically run between $3,000 and $8,000 depending on the length of your home and the complexity of the layout, and unlike seasonal lighting, it is a one-time install rather than something we take down each January.
included: Site assessment for your Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights kit
Concealed track mounting along roofline and trim
Wiring and power planning for a clean, safe install
App pairing and initial scene setup
Clean finish that stays hidden when the lights are off

sections.heading: How installation works
sections.text: We start by assessing your roofline and confirming your Govee kit has enough track and power supply for the coverage you want, since permanent systems are sized differently than seasonal string lights. Our crew mounts the track along the fascia or trim so it stays concealed during the day, then runs wiring to a suitable power source with proper weatherproofing at every connection point. Once mounted, we pair the system to your Govee app, confirm every zone responds correctly, and walk you through setting up your first scenes before we leave.

sections.heading: What affects the cost
sections.text: Permanent LED installs typically run between $3,000 and $8,000, with the main cost drivers being the linear footage of track being installed, the height and complexity of your roofline, and how much additional wiring or power supply work is needed to run the system cleanly. A straightforward bungalow roofline costs less than a home with multiple rooflines, dormers, or sections that need extra power planning to reach cleanly. We confirm your specific cost once we have assessed the property in person, before any track goes up.

sections.heading: What to expect after installation
sections.text: Once your Govee system is mounted and paired, you control it entirely through the app, switching between holiday colours, everyday accent lighting, or scenes for other occasions without anyone needing to climb a ladder again. Because it is a permanent install rather than a seasonal one, there is no annual takedown or spring reinstall to schedule. We do offer an optional service contract if you would like periodic checks on wiring, connections and weatherproofing as the seasons change year over year.

pricing: Govee permanent outdoor lighting installs typically cost between $3,000 and $8,000, depending on the length of track needed, roofline complexity, and the amount of wiring and power planning required. Because it is a one-time permanent install rather than a seasonal package, pricing reflects the electrical and mounting work rather than a per-season rate. We provide a custom quote after assessing your home.

faq.q: Do I need to buy the Govee kit myself, or do you supply it?
faq.a: This service covers professional installation of your Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights kit. We can advise on sizing before you purchase so you buy the right amount of track for your roofline, but the installation itself focuses on mounting, wiring and configuring the system properly once you have it in hand.

faq.q: How much does a Govee permanent light installation cost?
faq.a: Typical installs run between $3,000 and $8,000, depending on how much track your roofline needs and the complexity of the wiring and power supply work required to run it cleanly. We confirm an exact number after assessing your property in person, since every roofline and every home's power setup is a little different.

faq.q: Will the track be visible when the lights are off?
faq.a: We mount the track along your fascia or trim specifically to keep it concealed during the day, rather than sitting on top where it would be visible year round. The goal is a clean look whether the lights are on displaying a scene or off and blending quietly into your roofline.

faq.q: Do you set up the app and scenes, or just mount the hardware?
faq.a: Both. Once the track and wiring are installed, we pair the system to your Govee app, confirm every zone is responding correctly, and help you set up your first scenes so the system works properly and looks the way you want before we ever leave your property, rather than leaving the setup for you to figure out.
